title: Notify
description: Notify simplifies server management by providing high-visibility gradient notices, instant system alerts, and a fast, efficient staff-call interface.
body:
## 필요 모드(Dependencies)
https://modrinth.com/mod/pyke-lib

## 설명(Description)
Notify is an intuitive administrative utility that enhances server communication through high-visibility gradient announcements, instant system alerts, and a streamlined staff-call system.

## 명령어(Command)
```
/도움 <message>
/도움 쿨타임 <cooldown(ms)> OP
/staff-call <message>
/staff-call cooldown <cooldown(ms)> OP

/공지사항 <color> <message>  OP
/anc <color> <message>  OP
Color: RED / GOLD / YELLOW / LIME / AQUA / DARK_AQUA / BLUE / LIGHT_PURPLE / PURPLE

/알림 <duration(sec)> <message>  OP
/notice <duration(sec)> <message>  OP
```
